Spleen_mass_analysis

Zehao Wu

2026-04-19

First time run order: Spleen → CBC → ELISA

This markdown produces clean_meta_data.csv used by CBC and ELISA analysis. The section looking at the correlation between spleen size and lymphocyte counts at the bottom requires cleaned_combined_cbc_data.csv from CBC. That’s why CBC needs to be ran on the second try. But, this is only applicable if this is the first time this code is ran.

The analysis done in the ELISA code relies on the worm burden data cleaned here.

Setting the paths

base_path <- "/Users/zehao/Documents/Research Projects/Graham Group Thesis Research (Summer 2025)"

data_path <- file.path(base_path, 
                       "Metadata")
clean_data_path <- file.path(base_path, 
                             "Cleaned data")
figure_path <- file.path(base_path,

           showWarnings = FALSE, 
           recursive = TRUE)

Plot saver

plot_saver <- function(filename,
                       plot,
                       path = spleen_figure_path,
                       width = 6,
                       height = 4,
                       dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(filename = filename,
         plot = plot,
         path = path,
         width = width,
         height = height,
         units = "in",
         dpi = dpi)
}

svg_saver <- function(filename,
                      plot,
                      path = spleen_figure_path,
                      width = 6,
                      height = 4) {
  ggsave(filename = filename,
         plot = plot,
         path = path,
         width = width,
         height = height,
         units = "in",
         device = "svg")
}

Cleaning the spleen data

clean_spleen_data <- spleen_data %>% 
  filter(experiment == "NSF", 
         !is.na(`spleen mass (g)`)) %>%
  select(mouse.id, 
         strain, 
         T.muris.dose, 
         lab.or.rw, 
         `spleen mass (g)`) %>%
  clean_names() %>% 
  mutate(mouse_id = str_trim(as.character(mouse_id)),
         strain = as.character(strain),
         t_muris_dose = case_match(t_muris_dose, "0" ~ "Zero", .default = t_muris_dose),
         t_muris_dose = factor(t_muris_dose,
                                  levels = c("Zero", "Low", "High")),
         lab_or_rw = factor(lab_or_rw),
         spleen_mass_g = as.numeric(spleen_mass_g))

str(clean_spleen_data)

Cleaning the mass data

clean_body_mass_data <- body_mass_data %>% 
  filter(week == 3 | week == 4, 
         !is.na(mass)) %>% 
  select(mouse.id, 
         mass, 
         `cage/wedge`) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(mouse_id = str_trim(as.character(mouse_id)),
         mass = as.numeric(mass),
         cage_wedge = if_else(cage_wedge == "spare", 
                              "25", 
                              cage_wedge),
         cage_wedge = factor(cage_wedge))

str(clean_body_mass_data)
## tibble [109 × 3] (S3: tbl_df/tbl/data.frame)
##  $ mouse_id  : chr [1:109] "1304" "1305" "1309" "1310" ...
##  $ mass      : num [1:109] 22.8 25 23.7 23.3 22.3 23.2 23.3 24.4 23.7 21.8 ...
##  $ cage_wedge: Factor w/ 29 levels "1","10","11",..: 1 1 12 12 19 19 20 20 21 21 ...
# Let's assign the spares to cage 25 for ease of calculations.
# I'm going to only use week 3 and 4 since that's the end of the experiment

Cleaning splenocyte data

clean_spleen_lym_count <- spleen_lym_count %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  select(avg_total_cell_concentration_cell_m_l, 
         solution_volume_m_l, 
         mouse_id) %>%
  mutate(mouse_id = as.character(mouse_id) %>% str_trim(), 
         total_lym_number = avg_total_cell_concentration_cell_m_l * solution_volume_m_l,
         total_lym_number = as.numeric(total_lym_number)) %>%
  select(mouse_id,
         total_lym_number)

Cleaning worm burden data

day_map <- c("2025-07-22" = 1L,
             "2025-07-23" = 2L,
             "2025-07-29" = 3L,
             "2025-07-30" = 4L,
             "2025-08-04" = 5L)


clean_worm_burden <- worm_burden %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  select(mouse_id,
         total_worms,
         count_date) %>%
  select(mouse_id, total_worms, count_date) %>%

We want to include in a file called “compiled data.” But, before that I want to check to make sure the strains, ID, and the lab/rw conditions all match across the two data sets.

  1. Mouse ID
  2. Strain
  3. NSF Experiment
  4. T. muris Dosage
  5. Lab or RW
  6. Week 3 Body Mass
  7. Week 3 Spleen Mass

Checking for mistakes

compiled_data_strain_check <- clean_meta_data %>% 
  full_join(clean_spleen_data, 
            by = "mouse_id") %>%
  mutate(match = strain.x == strain.y) %>%
  filter(!match)

Creating compiled data

spleen_mass_compiled_data <- clean_meta_data %>% 
  left_join(clean_spleen_data, 
            by = "mouse_id") %>%
  left_join(clean_body_mass_data, 
            by = "mouse_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(spleen_mass_g), 
         !is.na(mass)) %>%
  select(mouse_id,
         strain = strain.x,
         lab_or_rw = lab_or_rw.x,
         t_muris_dose = t_muris_dose.x,
         spleen_mass_g,
         mass,
         cage_wedge,
         source,
         cohort) %>%
  mutate(strain = factor(strain),
         strain = relevel(strain, 
                          ref = "C57BL/6J"),
         t_muris_dose = factor(t_muris_dose,
                               levels = c("Zero",
                                          "Low",
                                          "High")),
         lab_or_rw = factor(lab_or_rw,
                            levels = c("Lab",
                                       "RW")))

Sample sizes per group

spleen_sample_counts <- spleen_mass_compiled_data %>%
  group_by(strain, lab_or_rw, t_muris_dose) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

Now I will calculate the spleen-mass ratio (SMR) and make a plot. Still thinking whether this is the correct way to do this. See the last plot.

Calculating spleen-mass ratio (SMR)

spleen_mass_compiled_data <- spleen_mass_compiled_data %>% 
  mutate(spleen_mass_ratio = spleen_mass_g/mass)

lym_number_spleen_data <- spleen_mass_compiled_data %>% 
  left_join(clean_spleen_lym_count, 
            by = "mouse_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(total_lym_number))

write_csv(lym_number_spleen_data,
          file.path(clean_data_path, 
                    "lym_number_spleen_data.csv"))

write_csv(spleen_mass_compiled_data,
          file.path(clean_data_path, 
                    "clean_compiled_spleen_data.csv"))

Filte the cbc data to join with spleen data

cbc_lym <- cbc_data %>%
  filter(phase == "Post-RW") %>%
  select(mouse_id, 
         lym_number) %>%
  mutate(mouse_id = str_trim(as.character(mouse_id)))

spleen_cbc <- spleen_mass_compiled_data %>% 
  left_join(cbc_lym,
            by = "mouse_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(lym_number),
         !is.na(spleen_mass_g))

Plotting SMR data

spleen_mass_ratio_plot <- ggplot(spleen_mass_compiled_data, 
                                 aes(x = t_muris_dose, 
                          y = spleen_mass_ratio, 
                          fill = lab_or_rw,
                          color = lab_or_rw,
                          group = interaction(t_muris_dose, 
                                              lab_or_rw))) + 
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
               alpha = 0.8,
               outlier.shape = NA,
               width = 0.5,
               color = "black",
               linewidth = 0.6) +
 geom_jitter(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15,
                                             dodge.width  = 0.75),
             alpha = 0.8,
             size = 1.8,
             shape = 21,
             color = "black") + 
  facet_wrap(~ strain) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("RW" = color_green,
                               "Lab" = color_grey),
                    name = expression(bold("Environment")),
                    labels = c("Lab" = "Lab",
                               "RW" = "Rewilded")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("RW" = color_green,
                                "Lab" = color_grey),
                     name = expression(bold("Environment")),
                     labels = c("Lab" = "Lab",
                                "RW" = "Rewilded")) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = expression(bold("Spleen to Body Mass Ratio (SMR)")),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.3))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white",
                                        color = "black",
                                        linewidth = 0.8),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 10,
                                  face = "bold"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black",
                                    fill = NA,
                                    linewidth = 0.8),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black",
                                  linewidth = 0.3),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")) +
  xlab(expression(bolditalic("T. muris")~bold("Dose"))) +
  ggtitle("Spleen to Body Mass Ratio (SMR)")

lmer modeling for SMR

smr_lmer <- lmer(spleen_mass_ratio ~ 
                   strain * 
                   lab_or_rw * 
                   t_muris_dose + 
                   (1 | cage_wedge), 
                 data = spleen_mass_compiled_data)

tab_model(smr_lmer, show.stat = TRUE)

emm_smr_plot <- ggplot(emm_smr_df) + 
  geom_point(aes(x = t_muris_dose, 
                 y = emmean, 
                 fill = lab_or_rw,
                 group = lab_or_rw),
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
             alpha = 1,
             size = 3,
             shape = 21,
             color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = t_muris_dose, 
                    ymin = lower.CL,
                    ymax = upper.CL, 
                    color = lab_or_rw,
                    group = lab_or_rw), 
                width = 0.3,
                alpha = 0.8,
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_point(data = spleen_mass_compiled_data,
             aes(x = t_muris_dose,
                 y = spleen_mass_ratio,
                 color = lab_or_rw),
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1,
                                             dodge.width = 0.5),
             alpha = 0.3,
             size = 1.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = expression(bold("Spleen to Body Mass Ratio (SMR)")),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.3))) +
  scale_x_discrete(name = expression(bolditalic("T. muris")~bold("Dose"))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Lab" = color_grey,
                               "RW" = color_green),
                    name = expression(bold("Environment")),
                    labels = c("Lab" = "Lab",
                              "RW" = "Rewilded")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Lab" = color_grey,
                                "RW" = color_green),
                     name = expression(bold("Environment")),
                     labels = c("Lab" = "Lab",
                              "RW" = "Rewilded")) +
  facet_wrap(~ strain) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white",
                                        color = "black",
                                        linewidth = 0.8),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 10,
                                  face = "bold"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black",
                                    fill = NA,
                                    linewidth = 0.8),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black",
                                  linewidth = 0.3),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")) +
  ggtitle("Marginal Means of SMR (95% CI)")

smr_sim_res <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = smr_lmer, n = 1000)

plot(smr_sim_res)

testUniformity(smr_sim_res)

## 
##  Asymptotic one-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test
## 
## data:  simulationOutput$scaledResiduals
## D = 0.080769, p-value = 0.5061
## alternative hypothesis: two-sided
testDispersion(smr_sim_res)

## 
##  DHARMa nonparametric dispersion test via sd of residuals fitted vs.
##  simulated
## 
## data:  simulationOutput
## dispersion = 0.89878, p-value = 0.518
## alternative hypothesis: two.sided
testOutliers(smr_sim_res)

## 
##  DHARMa outlier test based on exact binomial test with approximate
##  expectations
## 
## data:  smr_sim_res
## outliers at both margin(s) = 1, observations = 104, p-value = 0.1878
## alternative hypothesis: true probability of success is not equal to 0.001998002
## 95 percent confidence interval:
##  0.0002434108 0.0524106997
## sample estimates:
## frequency of outliers (expected: 0.001998001998002 ) 
##                                          0.009615385
plotResiduals(smr_sim_res, form = spleen_mass_compiled_data$lab_or_rw)

plotResiduals(smr_sim_res, form = spleen_mass_compiled_data$t_muris_dose)

plotResiduals(smr_sim_res, form = spleen_mass_compiled_data$strain)

emm_spleen_mass_plot <- ggplot(emm_spleen_mass_df) + 
  geom_point(aes(x = t_muris_dose, 
                 y = emmean, 
                 fill = lab_or_rw,
                 group = lab_or_rw),
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
             alpha = 1,
             size = 3,
             shape = 21,
             color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = t_muris_dose, 
                    ymin = lower.CL,
                    ymax = upper.CL, 
                    color = lab_or_rw,
                    group = lab_or_rw), 
                width = 0.3,
                alpha = 0.8,
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_point(data = spleen_mass_compiled_data,
             aes(x = t_muris_dose,
                 y = spleen_mass_g,
                 color = lab_or_rw),
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1,
                                             dodge.width = 0.5),
             alpha = 0.3,
             size = 1.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = expression(bold("Spleen Mass (g)")),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.3))) +
  scale_x_discrete(name = expression(bolditalic("T. muris")~bold("Dose"))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Lab" = color_grey,
                               "RW" = color_green),
                    name = expression(bold("Environment")),
                    labels = c("Lab" = "Lab",
                              "RW" = "Rewilded")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Lab" = color_grey,
                                "RW" = color_green),
                     name = expression(bold("Environment")),
                     labels = c("Lab" = "Lab",
                              "RW" = "Rewilded")) +
  facet_wrap(~ strain) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white",
                                        color = "black",
                                        linewidth = 0.8),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 10,
                                  face = "bold"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black",
                                    fill = NA,
                                    linewidth = 0.8),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black",
                                  linewidth = 0.3),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")) +
  ggtitle("Marginal Means of Spleen Mass (95% CI)")

We use log scale here to make sure that the whole thing fits.

spleen_mass_reg <- ggplot(spleen_mass_compiled_data, 
                                 aes(x = mass, 
                          y = spleen_mass_g, 
                          fill = lab_or_rw,
                          color = lab_or_rw,
                          group = lab_or_rw)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = t_muris_dose),
             alpha = 0.6,
             size = 1.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm",
              se = TRUE,
              alpha = 0.15,
              linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ strain) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Lab" = color_grey,
                               "RW" = color_green),
                    name = expression(bold("Environment")),
                    labels = c("Lab" = "Lab",
                               "RW" = "Rewilded")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Lab" = color_grey,
                               "RW" = color_green),
                    name = expression(bold("Environment")),
                    labels = c("Lab" = "Lab",
                               "RW" = "Rewilded")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Zero" = 1,
                                "Low" = 13,
                                "High" = 3),
                     name = expression(bolditalic("T. muris") ~
                                         bold("Dose"))) +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10",
                     name = expression(bold("Body Mass (g)"))) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10",
                     name = expression(bold("Spleen Mass (g)"))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white",
                                        color = "black",
                                        linewidth = 0.8),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 10,
                                  face = "bold"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black",
                                    fill = NA,
                                    linewidth = 0.8),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black",
                                  linewidth = 0.3),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")) +
  ggtitle("Spleen vs Body Mass")

Spleen mass adjusted for body mass for B6 and B10. I’m splitting the strains

to not overfit the model.

spleen_adj_lmer <- lmer(spleen_mass_g ~
                          lab_or_rw *
                          t_muris_dose * 
                          strain +
                          mass +
                          (1 | cage_wedge),
                        data = spleen_mass_compiled_data)

tab_model(spleen_adj_lmer,
          show.stat = TRUE)

                    group = t_muris_dose),
                width = 0.3,
                alpha = 0.8,
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_point(data = spleen_mass_compiled_data,
             aes(x = lab_or_rw,
                 y = spleen_mass_g,
                 color = t_muris_dose),
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1,
                                             dodge.width = 0.5),
             alpha = 0.3,
             size = 1.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = expression(bold("Spleen Mass Adjusted for Body Mass (g)")),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.3))) +
  scale_x_discrete(name = expression(bold("Environment")),
                   labels = c("Lab" = "Lab",
                              "RW" = "Rewilded")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Zero" = color_dark_blue,
                               "Low" = color_mustard,
                               "High" = color_orange),
                    name = expression(bolditalic("T. muris")~bold("Dose"))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Zero" = color_dark_blue,
                                "Low" = color_mustard,
                                "High" = color_orange),
                     name = expression(bolditalic("T. muris")~bold("Dose"))) +
  facet_wrap(~ strain) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white",
                                        color = "black",
                                        linewidth = 0.8),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 10,
                                  face = "bold"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black",
                                    fill = NA,
                                    linewidth = 0.8),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black",
                                  linewidth = 0.3),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")) +
  ggtitle("Marginal Means of Adjusted Spleen Mass (95% CI)")

Plotting the splenocyte count and spleen mass

spleen_mass_lym_count_plot <- ggplot(lym_number_spleen_data %>%
                                       mutate(strain = factor(strain,
                                                              levels = c("C57BL/6J", "B10.BR")),
                                              lab_or_rw = factor(lab_or_rw,
                                                                 levels = c("Lab", "RW")),
                                              t_muris_dose = factor(t_muris_dose,
                                                                    levels = c("Zero", "High"))),
                                     aes(x = spleen_mass_g,
                                         y = total_lym_number,
                                         fill = t_muris_dose)) +
  geom_point(size = 2,
             alpha = 0.8,
             shape = 21,
             color = "black") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm",
              se = TRUE,
              fill = "grey70",
              aes(group = t_muris_dose,
                  color = t_muris_dose),
              alpha = 0.2) +
  facet_grid(lab_or_rw ~ strain,
             labeller = labeller(lab_or_rw = c("Lab" = "Lab",
                                                "RW" = "Rewilded"))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Zero" = color_dark_blue,
                                "High" = color_orange),
                     name = expression(bolditalic("T. muris") ~ bold("Dose"))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Zero" = color_dark_blue,
                               "High" = color_orange),
                    name = expression(bolditalic("T. muris") ~ bold("Dose"))) +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10",
                     name = expression(bold("Spleen Mass (g)"))) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10",
                     name = expression(bold("Extracted Lymphocyte Count"))) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21,
                                                 color = "black")),
         color = "none") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", 
                                        color = "black", 
                                        linewidth = 0.8),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black",
                                    fill = NA, 
                                    linewidth = 0.8),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black",
                                  linewidth = 0.3),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")) +
  labs(title = "Spleen Mass vs. Lymphocyte Count")
